companyDescriptions.medium: Artanrecords is an independent record label founded by artist Artan Davoodi in 2025. We listen first. Accepted standard releases have no upfront base distribution fee, and artists retain their masters. Silver, Gold and Platinum describe different levels of agreed label involvement, not automatic acceptance or guaranteed results.
companyDescriptions.long:
Artanrecords is building an independent label from the artist side outward: the work, and the infrastructure behind it. Founded by Artan Davoodi in 2025, the label considers human-made music through individual review rather than an unrestricted upload pipeline.

Accepted standard releases have no upfront base distribution fee. Artists retain their master recordings; a written agreement defines the licence, responsibilities, recording-income shares and any approved expenses. Silver, Gold and Platinum describe progressively closer involvement, subject to project fit and capacity. Additional production, advertising, domains and other external services are not automatically included.

The website presents the label, artists, releases and partnerships. Docs explains the process in detail. Studio currently supports accounts and private artist profiles; release submissions, signing, financial reporting and payouts are not active. No partnership guarantees streams, playlists, press coverage or income.

introduction: A lasting home for the work
about: Artanrecords is a curated independent record label founded by Artan Davoodi in 2025. We listen first, then agree the right scope of release support. Artists retain their masters; accepted standard releases have no upfront base distribution fee.
principle: The infrastructure serves the art. We welcome music and creative collaborations through a considered, human-reviewed process. Each project begins with the work and the person behind it, not an automatic upload pipeline.
history: Founded in 2025 by Artan Davoodi, Artanrecords supports artists through release administration, catalogue presentation and creative collaboration. Each partnership begins with human review and an agreed scope of work.

aboutPage.description: About Artanrecords: an independent label founded in 2025, its artist-first mission and founder Artan Davoodi.
aboutPage.aboutDetails: Our public catalogue connects recordings with the people who made them. Dedicated artist and release pages bring together artwork, credits, release information and links to streaming services. Artist introductions and creative proposals are reviewed individually before any engagement is agreed.
aboutPage.missionDetails:
Our mission is to give artists and collaborators a clear, considered way to develop and present their work. We value accurate credits, coherent release information and respectful collaboration across music and visual practice.

We begin with listening and conversation. Release preparation and creative support are discussed for each project, with responsibilities and terms agreed before work begins. We do not treat every artist or recording as the same kind of project.
aboutPage.leadershipIntroduction: Artanrecords is founder-led. This section introduces the people responsible for the label and its direction.

leadership.biography: Artan Davoodi founded Artanrecords in 2025 to create an independent home for recordings and creative collaboration. A musician, songwriter and producer, he brings an artist's perspective to the label's direction and the way projects are reviewed and presented.
